Here is the plan for a live, test-run-only dashboard; nothing is built yet.

## What I found

- The platform lists 139 runs for the team: 133 test runs (kind `rehearsal`: 100 submitted, 25 failed, 8 running right now) and 6 scored runs.
- Runs in flight already report calls, tokens, cost, start and expiry, so a live view is possible without touching the agent.
- Every run carries a package hash, so runs of the same code can be grouped even when nobody recorded a note. Only 5 runs are in `experiments/runs.jsonl`.

   judgement: quality first, then cost × time; differences under 5 % count as the same. Builds with fewer than 2
   finished runs say "too few runs yet" instead of a verdict.
2. **Running now:** one row per run in flight: build, elapsed, calls, cost so far.
3. **Builds table, newest first** (the Atira leaderboard layout): Build, Runs, Quality, Time, Cost, Cost × time,
   and a "Progression" column in Atira's style (`100 → 100 → 5 → 100`) so an unstable build is obvious. An arrow next
   to each number shows better or worse than the build before.
4. **Runs of a build** (click a row): each run with status, quality, time, cost, calls and a link to the platform run
   page. Ticking two runs shows the points per field that differ.

platform package label when one exists.
